title: Basic notification delivery
purpose: Explain one central notification service between independent producers, channel providers and user endpoints; make baseline bottleneck clear.
alt: 여러 서비스에서 중앙 알림 서비스와 채널별 외부 제공자를 거쳐 사용자에게 전달되는 기본 구조
requiredChecks: Service1/ServiceN independently send notification requests to one Notification service.
Notification service routes to four channel alternatives APNs, FCM, SMS provider and Email provider, not a sequential chain.
Providers deliver to appropriate endpoints iOS device, Android device, Phone, Mailbox.
Baseline subtitle identifies single-service bottleneck; no guaranteed delivery or provider logos.
